title: A little less typing. A lot more cooking.
summary: Turn recipe screenshots into a first draft, bring a cookbook with you, and make ingredients easier to follow.

highlights.title: From screenshot to recipe
highlights.body: Paste, drop or select up to four screenshots. Optional Claude extraction fills the form; you review it before saving.

highlights.title: Your cookbook, unpacked
highlights.body: Import a Sizzle export with photos, notes and cooking history when your host enables cookbook imports.

highlights.title: Ingredients at a glance
highlights.body: Little ingredient icons, smarter quantity scaling and a choice of ingredient order or grouping.

sections.title: About this release
paragraphs: Sizzle is early in development. Expect rough edges and breaking changes between releases.

sections.title: What's new
paragraphs: Fill the Write a recipe form from pasted, dropped or selected screenshots using Claude. Review and save the result yourself; existing typed fields are preserved. Up to four images, 5 MB each. Screenshots are sent to Anthropic and are not retained by Sizzle.
Import Sizzle cookbook exports with recipes, photos, notes and cooking history. Existing recipes are skipped rather than overwritten. Enable with SIZZLE_COOKBOOK_IMPORT=true; it is off by default.
Ingredient icons and a choice of recipe order or grouping by type, remembered in your browser.
Parse quantities, units and preparation from plain ingredient lines for better serving scaling. An optional dry-run-first backfill task handles existing recipes.
Source previews on imports and recipes, including titles, descriptions and original links.
Failed-import header badge, Needs attention section and dismissal; older retries stay visible through completion.
Web imports default to automatic Claude fallback when configured, after local extraction. Existing saved browser preferences remain effective; Settings can disable Claude. API charges may apply.

sections.title: Fixes
paragraphs: Preserve method sections when saving a written recipe.
Harden extraction against hostile page content and tighten outbound URL protections.
Ignore malformed optional source metadata rather than failing imports.
Update image_processing to 2.2.0 with an explicit libvips backend.
Refresh marketing screenshots and installation guidance, and strengthen manual-recipe/browser tests.

sections.title: Upgrade
paragraphs: Four migrations run automatically: source metadata, dismissed-import timestamps, recipe IDs and cookbook-import tracking. No Compose changes are required. Cookbook import is opt-in through SIZZLE_COOKBOOK_IMPORT=true. Screenshot extraction requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
Before upgrading, stop Sizzle and back up the complete storage volume using the documented stop/copy/start procedure: https://github.com/leemac/sizzle/blob/main/docs/self-hosting.md#back-up

Pin SIZZLE_VERSION=0.3.1, then run docker compose pull and docker compose up -d. Rollback requires restoring the pre-upgrade storage backup and pinning 0.3.0; switching images alone does not reverse migrations.

sections.title: Known limitations
paragraphs: Sizzle has no login; keep it on a trusted network or behind authentication. Existing recipes do not receive source metadata retroactively. Ingredient backfilling is optional and is not performed automatically.

sections.title: About this release
paragraphs: Sizzle is early in development. Expect rough edges and breaking changes between releases.

sections.title: What's new
paragraphs: Pick a theme and light, dark or automatic mode for each browser. Enable the optional editor to create shared custom themes.
Use SOS to find recipes for the current meal, with seasonal recipes first. Edit meal times and seasons on your recipes.
Set cooking text size, screen wake lock, recipe order and Claude import permission in Settings. Download a portable cookbook archive with recipes, photos and cooking history.
Install and connect the optional prebuilt iPhone Shortcut without copying the server API token; revoke individual connections from Sizzle.
Printed recipes show when they were added, cooked and printed. The logo gains a hover animation, and the landing page has refreshed seasonal recipe previews.

sections.title: Fixes
paragraphs: Share an import budget across web requests, the API and retries; bound image download attempts and redact imported content and URLs from application logs.

sections.title: Upgrade
paragraphs: Before upgrading, stop Sizzle, copy the complete storage volume using the backup procedure, then restart it. Do not copy a live SQLite database.

Set SIZZLE_VERSION=0.3.0 in .env, then run docker compose pull && docker compose up -d. Four migrations run automatically: custom themes, per-import AI permission, shortcut connections, and recipe meal times/seasons. Existing recipes receive initial meal times from their course and seasons from matching tags.

The Compose files and dependency locks are unchanged. Two optional settings are new and default off: SIZZLE_THEME_EDITOR=true and SIZZLE_SHORTCUT_PAIRING=true. Add either to .env and recreate the container to enable it. Anyone who can reach the web UI can edit shared themes or pair shortcuts when enabled. The existing token-protected script API remains available.
Web imports now ask for Claude permission by default; browser Settings can allow automatic fallback. Phone and script imports retain the server's AI configuration.
To roll back, stop Sizzle, restore the complete pre-upgrade storage backup and pin the previous image version. Changing the image alone does not undo database migrations.

sections.title: Known limitations
paragraphs: Sizzle has no login. Keep it on a trusted private network or behind an authenticating reverse proxy.
Cookbook exports are bounded portable downloads, not complete server backups; importing an export into Sizzle is not yet supported.
Keeping the screen awake requires browser support and HTTPS or localhost.

iPhone Shortcut installation and manual execution have been confirmed; end-to-end pairing and recipe import on a physical iPhone remain unverified. The shortcut stores one cookbook connection per Apple account in iCloud Drive; reverse-proxy authentication may need additional setup.

sections.title: About this release
paragraphs: Sizzle is early in development. Expect rough edges and breaking changes between releases.

sections.title: What's new
paragraphs: Group ingredients with headings when writing recipes, and adjust quantities with half/double controls or a target serving count. Scaling leaves the saved recipe unchanged.
Print a recipe card with your selected servings, designed to fit A4 or Letter. Very long recipes can continue onto more pages.
Review duplicate links before importing, choose whether to restore archived recipes, and follow progress beside the import form.

Open YouTube directions from recipes. New imports retain video duration, description chapters, and a written-recipe link when available. Existing recipes get the video link without a metadata backfill.
Use a dark cookbook with photo-colored recipe headers and a version link in the footer. The marketing site gains seasonal recipe stacks and screenshots that follow system appearance.

sections.title: Fixes
paragraphs: Recognize tracking variants and historical redirect aliases during duplicate review.
Preserve manual recipe fields when a source link already belongs to a saved recipe.
Correct quantity scaling for spaced Unicode mixed fractions.

sections.title: Upgrade
paragraphs: Before upgrading, stop Sizzle and back up the complete storage volume using the documented stop/copy/start procedure.
Set SIZZLE_VERSION=0.2.0 in .env, then run docker compose pull and docker compose up -d. Startup automatically adds the recipe video-metadata column. No new settings or Compose changes are required.
The /setup page has been removed. Optional AI remains configured through ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server; the running version appears in the footer.
To roll back, restore the complete pre-upgrade storage backup and pin the previous image version. Changing the image alone does not undo the migration.

sections.title: Known limitations
paragraphs: There is no login. Keep Sizzle on a private network or behind an authenticating reverse proxy.
YouTube imports read descriptions and linked recipe pages, not spoken audio.
Very long unbroken text can overflow the recipe screen on narrow displays.

sections.title: About this release
paragraphs: Sizzle is early in development. Expect rough edges and breaking changes between releases. Keep it on a home or private network: there is no login yet.

sections.title: What's new
paragraphs: Import several recipe links at once: paste up to 20 links into Add recipe.
Import recipes from YouTube video descriptions, including a recipe page linked from the description. Recipes that are only spoken in a video are not supported.
Record when you make a recipe with I made this, see how often and when you last made it, and undo an accidental entry.
Choose a grid or list for your cookbook; Sizzle remembers the choice in your browser. Gallery cards have a new layout.
Follow sharing instructions for iPhone, Android, or computer, with clearer server addresses for setting up the iOS Shortcut.

sections.title: Improvements and fixes
paragraphs: Page titles are correct on the first load.
A simpler empty cookbook and clearer recipe details, including relative added and edited times.
Updated installation documentation and website previews.
Development setup installs a pinned secret scanner and fixes its PATH fallback.

sections.title: Upgrade from v0.0.1
paragraphs: Back up the complete sizzle-storage volume with Sizzle stopped, following the backup instructions.
To pin this release, set SIZZLE_VERSION=0.1.0 in your existing .env.
Run docker compose pull followed by docker compose up -d.

The database migration runs automatically on startup. It adds cooking-history records, a cook count, and an edited timestamp. No new environment settings or Compose changes are required relative to v0.0.1.
To roll back, restore your backup and pin SIZZLE_VERSION=0.0.1 before starting Sizzle. Changing only the image version does not reverse a database migration.

sections.title: Known limitations
paragraphs: There is no login. Use a home network or a private network such as Tailscale.
YouTube imports need a recipe in the description or its linked page; Sizzle does not transcribe videos. Some videos may be unavailable from your server.
Pages without usable recipe data and unstructured pasted text require the optional Anthropic API key, or manual recipe entry.
